2.source: relic set 302 (不老者的仙舟 / Fleet of the Ageless), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's Max HP by #1[i]%. When the wearer's SPD is equal to or higher than #2[i], increases all allies' ATK by #3[i]%." param = [0.12, 120, 0.08]
2.note: Only the conditional sentence is here; the wearer's "Max HP +12%" is the effect's `properties` stat (HPAddedRatio 0.12), applied by RelicSuit -- writing it again would double it. ⚠ `target: all_allies` is what makes this the WHOLE party and not just the wearer: the wearer's own SPD is the gate, but the bonus lands on everyone, and getting that wrong would be invisible in a solo test. ⚠ Same BATTLE_START approximation as sets 301/307/309 ("when the wearer's SPD is >= 120" is continuous in the text).
